scheduleIII.title: Financial statements · Schedule III
scheduleIII.subtitle: {{company}} · Companies Act 2013, Schedule III, Division I · balances at {{date}} · before audit, depreciation and tax · amounts in ₹
scheduleIII.noCompany: No company yet. Add one under Admin → Companies.
scheduleIII.balanced: Balanced · assets equal equity and liabilities
scheduleIII.difference: Difference ₹{{amount}} · check the books before sharing
scheduleIII.caNotConfirmed: Mapping not yet confirmed by the CA
scheduleIII.plTitle: Statement of profit and loss · {{from}} to {{to}}
scheduleIII.broughtForward: Profit of earlier periods (in reserves and surplus)
scheduleIII.plNote: Profit of this and earlier periods is carried to reserves and surplus. Depreciation and tax are shown only once they are booked.
scheduleIII.unmappedBody: These account groups have no Schedule III line yet. Their balances stay on their natural side (shown as “not yet mapped”) so the sheet still balances. Map them below.
scheduleIII.mapTitle: Mapping · account groups to Schedule III lines
scheduleIII.mapNote: {{mapped}} of {{total}} groups mapped. A group's sub-groups follow it unless they have their own line.
scheduleIII.mapConfirmed: The CA has confirmed the current mapping.
scheduleIII.mapNotConfirmed: Changing a line clears the CA's confirmation; record it again once the CA agrees.
scheduleIII.adminOnly: Only Admin changes the mapping. Ask Admin if a line looks wrong.
scheduleIII.noGroupsBody: Groups come from the Tally import or Admin → Tally books → Chart of accounts.
scheduleIII.confirmEffect_one: Marks the mapping of {{count}} group as confirmed by the CA, with your note. It is logged.
scheduleIII.confirmEffect_other: Marks the mapping of {{count}} groups as confirmed by the CA, with your note. It is logged.
scheduleIII.caNote: CA's note (who confirmed it and how)
scheduleIII.caNoteHelp: The CA's own login is read-only, so Admin records the confirmation with the CA's note (at least 5 characters).
scheduleIII.viewAdmin: Admin: every transaction, with GST and without GST, each bill without GST marked. These statements and the returns are made from all of them.
scheduleIII.viewOthers: Everyone else: transactions with GST only, in every list, report and export.
scheduleIII.viewCa: The CA: every transaction, read-only, to prepare and audit the accounts.
scheduleIII.gstOnly: You are seeing the statements built from GST transactions only.
scheduleIII.caTitle: For the CA to settle before the statements are final
scheduleIII.caBody: Depreciation and income tax are not booked, so profit will come down. Opening balances, loans to directors, cash in hand and anything shown as “not yet mapped” are reviewed with the CA before the statements are shared.

rules.group: That account group was not found. Reload the page and try again.
rules.line: That Schedule III line is not known. Choose a line from the list.
rules.note: Write the CA's note: who confirmed the mapping and how (at least 5 characters).
